sys_di_key.description:
Extract the Total Debt (all borrowings) as at the balance sheet date.
This field may appear under any of these labels: - Total Debt, Total Borrowings, Total Loans - Secured Loans + Unsecured Loans (SUM both) - Bank OD A/c, Cash Credit (CC), Overdraft - Term Loans, Bank Term Loan - Loans (Liability) — sum all sub-items - Bank of Baroda T/L, HDFC OD, SBI CC etc. — sum all bank loan lines - Long Term Borrowings + Short Term Borrowings (for company balance sheets) If sum of secured loans and unsecured is not present then sum both the both the values and return the amount Rules: - SUM: Secured Loans + Unsecured Loans + Bank OD/CC + Term Loans - EXCLUDE: Sundry Creditors, trade payables, statutory liabilities - EXCLUDE: Capital Account, partner loans that are classified as capital - Return plain number only. If not found, return: NA
sys_di_key.name: Total Debt
